// GREEN fixture for `no-raw-publish` — the REFS slice (REF-P2 / P-053). The lint MUST admit this.
//
// The same refs-edge extractor, now emitting the `refs.edge.*` event through `OutboxTx::emit` in
// the SAME transaction as the structured node write (emit-iff-committed, contract 5.4): one edge
// per structured node, co-committed with the source. The relay is the only component on the broker
// publish side — there is no standalone edge-write path.
pub async fn extract_edges(tx: &mut OutboxTx, node: &StructuredNode) -> Result<(), Error> {
    tx.write_structured_node(node)?;
    let draft = edge_event_for(node);
    // OK: the edge event is emitted in-transaction via the outbox — co-committed with its source.
    tx.emit(draft, Cause::from_node(node))?;
    tx.commit().await
}
